roadmap.title: Play the story naturally
roadmap.text: Run the campaign start to finish without chasing trophies. Several unlock on their own, and you learn the map you need for phase two.

roadmap.title: Sweep the open world
roadmap.text: With free roam fully open, clear collectibles and region milestones in passes by area: Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, the park.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and grind
roadmap.text: Replay any missions you did not 100% the first time, finish the money and stat trophies, and take the Platinum.

items.name: Welcome to the Keys
items.desc: Set foot in the Leonida Keys for the first time.

items.name: Two to Tango
items.desc: Switch between Jason and Lucia 50 times.
items.how: You will get most of the way there by playing normally. Finish it off by swapping back and forth while standing still.

items.name: Sunset Pier
items.desc: Watch a full sunset from the Vice City boardwalk.

items.name: Short Count
items.desc: Finish the mission that sets everything in motion.

items.name: Clean Hands
items.desc: Complete any story mission without taking damage.

items.name: State of Leonida
items.desc: Discover every district on the map.

items.name: The Long Way Down
items.desc: Make a one-time story choice in the final act.

items.name: Collector
items.desc: Find every Hidden Icon across the state.

items.name: 100% Leonida
items.desc: Reach full game completion. Earn every other trophy.
